Guardrail: playbook.ts never imports finding_add/advisory; proposal ids are globally unique across proposals/ + playbooks.json.
usage: lattice playbook_propose --finding <id>; playbook_diff <pid>; playbook_approve <pid> --expectedProposalDigest <d>; playbook_reject <pid>. Proof: npm --prefix packages/main run test:experience-layer-playbook (=> 'smoke passed').

Playbooks are not yet surfaced into reviewer prompts as playbook-sourced hints (Phase 1.5 surfaces finding-signals; wiring playbooks in is future). Cross-project sharing (Phase 4) out of scope.
pitfalls: Proposal ids must be globally unique across BOTH proposals/ and playbooks.json — scanning only proposals/ reuses ids after approve clears them (was F-003). Import the digest helper from core/digest.js (leaf), never from the decision-doc handler. approve must fail closed on stale/missing expectedProposalDigest and yield candidate (not active). High-finding round -> escalation quorum required; degraded 3x1 must bind to DONE materialHash; DONE evidence-freshness needs re-validate (not just refresh_stale).
